message:
test(viewer): fake host applies the seq gap in front of the next keyframe, not the next AU

S7 / S12 model the product's "gap then IDR" (the sender queue cleared by an IDR consumes a
seq). On an asynchronous encoder the call that submits the forced key may first return the
previous P, so a gap applied to the next AU sometimes sat in front of that P -- a lossy
shape the viewer rightly answers with a request (reason 3), which made S7 flaky (1 in ~3
runs). The gap now waits for the key AU.
